thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the Query Policy Layer RFC — can we decide how policy evaluation gets applied per-panel? I'm worried about adding tail latency to dashboard loads.

alex: Short answer: don't run a full policy engine inline for every panel. We should offload to a QPL worker and return a small hint (allow/rewrite/mask) that the console can apply. Cold path needs thought.

ben: Per-panel checks could still add 10-30ms if unbatched. Can we batch across panels in the same dashboard load?

sasha: Yes — propose the QPL accepts a batch of "policy-requests" and returns decisions + optional rewrite templates. Response shape: (decision, cache_suffix, rewrite). If rewrite==null -> no re-run.

maria: Example config I'd expect in console: 
```yaml
qpl: 
  batch_window_ms: 12
  max_batch: 64
  fallback: deny
  allow_stale_hint: true
```
(we'll tune values later)

alex: Also add per-tenant hint TTL so cached panel responses include "policy_hint_ttl" — console can show stale:true instead of blocking. UX can decide.

ben: Operational SLO thought: policy eval p75 < 20ms, p95 < 60ms. If exceeded, QPL should flip tenants into safe-mode (simple allow/deny) to preserve dashboard latencies.

jason: Important note on RBAC integration: QPL must reuse the existing token introspection cache. Don't re-evaluate full token->roles mapping in QPL; pass role-set in the request so we don't duplicate.

sasha: Rollout plan: implement shadow mode first (responses recorded but not enforced), 2-week telemetry window, then opt-in beta tenants, then gradual enforce. Ops will need a canary flag.

maria: Action items: alex -> spike batching prototype + microbench; ben -> SLO tests and telemetry dashboard; sasha -> console SDK changes (apply hints, handle rewrite); jason -> token cache contract. I'll own rollout doc & QA checklist.

maria: Also question: do we want rewrite responses to be deterministic transforms (preferred) or arbitrary re-query suggestions? Deterministic lets console avoid extra fetch.

alex: Prefer deterministic template rewrites. Arbitrary re-query invites new fanout. Only allow re-query for heavyweight panels with explicit opt-in.

maria: Cool. I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with the config snippet and the rollout steps.

maria: pinging @deploy-bot to queue canary infra once we have a build. :rocket:

deploy-bot: infra: canary rollout queued for qpl-service:v1 -> 4 hosts in prod-canary. Logs available at https://infra.internal/redwood/qpl/canary/3051234567

alex: I'll post PR with benchmark numbers by Wed. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ben: adding note — we should record a sample of policy decisions per-tenant (hashed) so we can replay regressions without exposing PII.

jason: Agreed. Keep the sample hashed + TTL-limited.

sasha: OK good plan. I'll align SDK PR with the shadow telemetry fields.

maria: Great sync. We'll review the follow-up RFC in next architecture huddle.
